purpose: Prevent visually attractive but field-inaccurate assets. Before any rendering, confirm the object/control as actually used in Korean construction sites, then confirm safety/legal function, then render.

source_priority.source: user-provided current-site photos and direct field observations
source_priority.rule: When available, treat as ground truth for the exact site configuration and visible geometry.

source_priority.source: current Korean official guidance and law (KOSHA / 국가법령정보센터 / KCs certification)
source_priority.rule: Confirm terminology, required safety function, certification category and any statutory geometry before drawing.

source_priority.source: current Korean manufacturer or supplier product documentation
source_priority.rule: Confirm that the proposed product family and visible hardware are actually sold/used in Korea. Use at least one Korean product source when the item is a purchasable material/equipment.
Texture and lighting only. Never establish geometry or naming from generic global imagery.

pre_generation_gate: Identify whether the target is a physical product, a site-specific assembly, a hazard condition, or a runtime overlay.
Search Korean official guidance/law for the function and terminology.
For purchasable items, confirm at least one current Korean manufacturer/supplier product family before rendering.
If a user/current-site photo exists, compare it with the Korean reference and record any site-specific difference.
Record exact visible geometry, connections, material, stabilization and load-transfer relationship.
Do not render while the exact product family or scene type is unresolved.
post_generation_gate: Compare generated geometry side-by-side with the Korean reference and any current-site photo.
Reject foreign/generic hardware not evidenced by the reference.
Reject invented fasteners, connectors, dimensions, markings or structural members.
Reject a physical 3D prop when the item is actually a route overlay, ground condition or exclusion-zone composition.
Only approved assets proceed to binary registration and catalog final.

observed_configuration: galvanized steel standards and ledgers in a dense grid
adjustable jack bases at slab level with base plates/support pads
U-head screw jacks at the top of standards
steel bearer/mong-e members physically seated in the U-heads
upper horizontal connecting/stabilizing members visible around the U-head/bearer zone
perforated steel work-platform/deck panels used through the shoring grid
diagonal bracing present in applicable bays
real site context includes wall/column formwork and active RC construction
must_preserve: jack base -> standard -> U-head -> bearer/mong-e -> slab formwork load path
ledger grid connected at the standard nodes
actual upper-level stabilization relationship visible in the supplied photos
realistic spacing/proportions instead of generic scaffold spacing
physically seated U-head and bearer with no floating or impossible contact
reject: bearer floating above or beside U-head
generic scaffold substituted for system shoring
missing ledgers or invented diagonal members inconsistent with reference
cartoon/pictogram simplification that hides connection logic

evidence_rule.technical_function_claims: Cross-check with Korean safety guidance or manufacturer documentation when needed.
evidence_rule.uncertainty: If a component function cannot be confirmed from the reference, mark it unresolved and do not invent it.

episode01_priority.rule: Episode 01 visible runtime props and Section 0 Field Guide assets are verified and completed before resuming later-section mass production.
